title: Disabling cellular watch's connection
symptom: The Wear OS watch (Huawei Watch 2 LTE) disables cellular connection when battery is 15% or less, and re-enables after charging above 15%. Also, when the watch is at rest for 30-60 minutes and not connected to the phone via Bluetooth, it enters a deep sleep mode and loses cellular data connectivity, preventing transmission of readings from the watch's collector to the phone.
cause: The thread suggests that the Wear OS service puts the watch into a deep sleep mode after 30-60 minutes of inactivity, which disables cellular data connectivity. The user speculates that this is due to the watch being at rest and lacking Bluetooth connection to the phone.
evidence_quote: Nevertheless sometimes my watch goes into something like a "deep sleep mode" and loses cellular data connectivity.
